Terms of Service

The rules of using this website and your MemoryCare account.

Draft for legal review · Effective date: 12 September 2026 (pending final legal sign-off) · MEMORY CARE LLC, Komitas Avenue 47/1, apt. 9, Yerevan, Armenia

1. Parties

These Terms are an agreement between MEMORY CARE LLC (“MemoryCare”, “we”) and you, the person creating an account or placing an order on mc.makyan.com. By creating an account or placing an order you accept these Terms, the Service provision terms, the Refund & cancellation policy and the Privacy policy.

2. The service

MemoryCare provides inspection, cleaning and care of family memorial plots in cemeteries of the Republic of Armenia, with a photo and video report after every visit. Plans, their contents and prices are published on the Plans & prices section and are stated in Armenian drams (AMD, ֏), VAT included.

3. Account

You must provide accurate contact details and keep your password secret. You are responsible for actions taken under your account. You confirm that you are a relative of the person(s) buried at the plot or are authorised by the family to order care for it.

4. Orders and payment

An order is placed in the account and paid by bank card (Visa, Mastercard, ArCa) through Ameriabank’s secure payment page. One-time visits are paid before the visit. Annual plans are paid once in full; visits are delivered over the following 12 months according to a schedule agreed with you. Recurring charges are never made without your explicit separate consent. Prices at the moment of payment apply.

5. Performance

Visit dates are agreed with you in advance. A visit is considered performed when its report (photos, video, GPS coordinates, date and time) is published in your account. Where weather or cemetery access makes a visit impossible on the agreed date, we reschedule at no cost.

6. Cancellation and refunds

Governed by the Refund & cancellation policy. Refunds are made only to the card used for payment, through the bank.

7. Liability

We take reasonable care of the plot and use stone-safe methods. We are not liable for pre-existing damage, natural deterioration of the stone, acts of third parties, or restrictions imposed by cemetery administration. Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the affected visit.

8. Intellectual property

Site content and the MemoryCare name and logo belong to MEMORY CARE LLC. Report photos and videos of your plot are yours to download and share.

9. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia. Disputes are resolved by negotiation first; failing that, by the competent courts of Yerevan.
